curatedMovie.curiosityHook: How will three separate journeys home reveal the pressures each traveler is already carrying?
curatedMovie.description: On election day in Italy, three men journey home: an immigrant returning from Munich, an obsessive Roman civil servant testing his wife's patience, and a young man derailed by his grandmother's fragile health.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A steady, multi-strand Italian comedy balancing family stress and homecoming with warm, moderate emotional weight.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Carlo Verdone crafts a funny yet grounded road comedy that balances domestic exasperation and cultural homecoming with sharp, observant character portraits.
